name: laundry-plugs
description: Laundry Plugs - is the washing machine free yet?
author: Aleks-Daniel Jakimenko-Aleksejev <alex.jakimenko@gmail.com>

scripts.check-everything: pnpm format && pnpm -C database exec tsgo && pnpm -C frontend exec quasar prepare && pnpm -r check && pnpm lint
scripts.check-everything-slow: pnpm format && pnpm -C database exec tsgo && pnpm -C frontend exec quasar prepare && pnpm -r check && pnpm lint-slow
scripts.drop: psql -d postgres -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS laundry_plugs WITH (FORCE);" && psql -d postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE laundry_plugs;" && pnpm -C database exec drizzle-kit migrate
